genesis.12.p1.b1.text: “Leave your country, your kindred, and your father’s household, and go to the land I will show you.

genesis.12.p1.b2.text: I will make you into a great nation, and I will bless you; I will make your name great, so that you will be a blessing.

genesis.12.p1.b3.text: … all the families of the earth will be blessed through you.”

genesis.12.p2.b4.text: So Abram departed, as the LORD had directed him, and Lot went with him. Abram was seventy-five years old when he left Haran.

genesis.12.p2.b5.text: … and all the possessions and people they had acquired in Haran, and set out for the land of Canaan. When they came to the land of Canaan …

genesis.12.p2.b6.text: Abram traveled through the land as far as the site of the Oak of Moreh at Shechem. And at that time the Canaanites were in the land.

genesis.12.p3.b7.text: “I will give this land to your offspring.”

genesis.12.p3.b8.text: So Abram built an altar there to the LORD, who had appeared to him.

genesis.12.p3.b9.text: … There he built an altar to the LORD, and he called on the name of the LORD.

genesis.12.p4.b10.text: Now there was a famine in the land. So Abram went down to Egypt to live there for a while because the famine was severe.

genesis.12.p4.b11.text: “Look, I know that you are a beautiful woman, and when the Egyptians see you, they will say, ‘This is his wife.’ Then they will kill me but will let you live.

genesis.12.p4.b12.text: Please say you are my sister …

genesis.12.p5.b13.text: So when Abram entered Egypt, the Egyptians saw that the woman was very beautiful.

genesis.12.p5.b14.text: When Pharaoh’s officials saw Sarai, they commended her to him, and she was taken into the palace of Pharaoh.

genesis.12.p5.b15.text: He treated Abram well on her account, and Abram acquired sheep and cattle, male and female donkeys, menservants and maidservants, and camels.

genesis.12.p6.b16.text: The LORD, however, afflicted Pharaoh and his household with severe plagues because of Abram’s wife Sarai.

genesis.12.p6.b17.text: “What have you done to me? Why didn’t you tell me she was your wife?

genesis.12.p6.b18.text: … Now then, here is your wife. Take her and go!”

genesis.12.p6.b19.text: Then Pharaoh gave his men orders concerning Abram, and they sent him away with his wife and all his possessions.
